What we design

From a single room to a full home, we handle the thinking and the details.

Residential interiors

Commercial spaces

Space planning

Furniture layouts and lighting plans that make every square foot useful.

Custom furniture and joinery

How we work

Three clear phases, from the first conversation to your final approval.

  1. Planning

    Understanding your vision, lifestyle, and aspirations to shape a thoughtful design direction and a clear roadmap for your dream space.

  2. Concept development & 3D

    Bringing your ideas to life through personalized mood boards, site visits, and immersive 3D visuals that help you envision your future space.

  3. Final blueprint

    Translating your approved vision into detailed 2D drawings and a transparent project BOQ, ensuring every detail feels just right for you.

Meet Nungshi Singh

Nungshi founded Artinn Decors on a simple belief: a well-designed room should make daily life easier, calmer and more personal.

She leads every project herself, working closely with each client from the first sketch to the last cushion. Her approach favors honest materials, generous light and spaces that are built to be lived in.
